name: @yuhe520521/reme
description: AGH plugin for ReMe file-native long-term memory search and management

metadata.summary: Search and manage ReMe long-term memory
metadata.description: Connects to a ReMe HTTP service to search long-term memory, capture conversation turns, and run memory consolidation. Auto-capture and scheduled dream are degraded to explicit tool calls in AGH.

zh-CN.summary: 搜索和管理 ReMe 长期记忆
zh-CN.description: 连接 ReMe HTTP 服务以搜索长期记忆、捕获对话轮次并运行记忆整理。自动捕获和定时梦境在 AGH 中降级为显式工具调用。
